[[Victo's Blade]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] dropped by [[The_Darkness_(boss)|The Darkness]], a [[boss]] who can be found in the [[The Hall of Heroes (explorable area)]].
==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Life Draining]]: 3
:[[Health regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item has the same [[skin]] as the [[Shadow Blade]].
